params.name: picture
params.description: Picture field or variable to convert.

params.name: pictureBlob
params.description: BLOB to receive the converted picture.

params.name: codec
params.description: Picture Codec ID (extension, e.g. ".gif", or Mime type, e.g. "image/jpeg").

overloads.semanticRole: The PICTURE TO BLOB command converts a picture stored in a 4D variable or field to another format and places the resulting picture in a BLOB.

constraints: On success, the OK system variable is set to 1 and pictureBlob contains the converted picture; on failure (converter not available) OK is set to 0 and pictureBlob is returned empty (0 byte).
Valid codec values can be obtained via the PICTURE CODEC LIST command.
